title: Discrete Diffusion Inference-Time Control with Nested Sequential Monte Carlo
abstract: arXiv:2608.20123v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We study inference-time control for text generation in discrete diffusion language models, where the goal is to steer sampling toward sequence-level rewards without retraining. Prior work in this domain has focused on particle-based methods such as best-of-$n$ sampling and bootstrap sequential Monte Carlo, which may suffer from overoptimism and weight degeneracy, respectively. We address these limitations using \emph{nested} sequential Monte Carlo methods. We formulate nested SMC (NSMC) and fully-adapted nested SMC (FA-NSMC) for Feynman--Kac steering, identifying and correcting errors in prior formulations that lead to biased final estimates. We evaluate these methods on toxicity and fluency steering tasks, showing that NSMC and FA-NSMC consistently outperform best-of-$n$ and bootstrap SMC.

translated_title: 离散扩散模型推断时控制的嵌套序贯蒙特卡洛方法
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.20123v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：我们研究了离散扩散语言模型中文本生成的推断时控制问题，其目标是在不重新训练的情况下，将采样引导至序列级奖励。此前该领域的工作主要集中于基于粒子的方法，如最佳-$n$采样和自举序贯蒙特卡洛，这些方法可能分别遭受过度乐观和权重退化问题。我们通过使用\emph{嵌套}序贯蒙特卡洛方法来解决这些限制。我们为费曼-卡克转向制定了嵌套序贯蒙特卡洛（NSMC）和完全自适应嵌套序贯蒙特卡洛（FA-NSMC），识别并纠正了先前公式中导致最终估计偏差的错误。我们在毒性和流畅性转向任务上评估了这些方法，结果表明NSMC和FA-NSMC始终优于最佳-$n$和自举序贯蒙特卡洛。
tldr: 该论文提出嵌套序贯蒙特卡洛方法（NSMC和FA-NSMC）用于离散扩散模型的推断时控制，有效解决了先前方法中的过度乐观和权重退化问题，在毒性和流畅性任务上性能更优。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces nested sequential Monte Carlo methods (NSMC and FA-NSMC) for inference-time control in discrete diffusion models, addressing overoptimism and weight degeneracy, and achieving superior performance on toxicity and fluency tasks.
